- The address form is one page
- Payment uses the saved card by default

See the [pull request](https://example.org/pr/42).

files_content./Users/me/web/.sbxw-artifacts/codemap/co:
# Web app

The storefront and its API client. Start with [[cli]] for the commands, then [[net#Proxy]] for how requests leave.

## Areas

- [[cli]]: the command line
- [[net|the network layer]], see `src/net/proxy.ts`
- [[billing]]: gone since the rewrite

Source entry point: [[src/main.ts]]. More at https://example.org/web-app.
files_content./Users/me/web/.sbxw-artifacts/codemap/cl:
# CLI

## Commands

`web serve` starts the dev server. It reads the [[net#proxy]] settings.

## Flags

- `--port`: the port to listen on
- `--open`: opens the browser
files_content./Users/me/web/.sbxw-artifacts/codemap/ne:
# Net

## Proxy

Requests go through the proxy in [[src/net/proxy.ts]]. Back to [[codemap|the index]].

## Retries

Three tries, then the error. A quoted example stays text: `[[not-a-link]]`.

```ts
// [[inside-fence]] is not a link either
retry(3)
```
